_about: The built-in words’ pictures (ADR 0039, W9). Made 2026-11-16 with openai/gpt-5-image-mini through OpenRouter: the same style prompt for every word with the word’s subject put in, two takes each, the better one picked and checked by a person, then cut to 512 px WebP with near-white made pure white. Owned by the project, released as CC0.
prompt: A simple, friendly flat cartoon colour picture for a 3-year-old child. The picture shows: {subject}. One clear subject, centred, filling most of the square picture with a little white space around it. Bold, rounded, simple shapes with smooth dark outlines, bright cheerful colours, flat colour fills with no gradients, no texture and no shading. Plain white background with nothing else in the picture: no ground, no frame, no border. Absolutely no text, no letters, no numbers, no words, no signs or labels anywhere in the picture. Original design, not any well-known cartoon character or brand. Square image.
